'''Ulrich Kutschera''' (born 2 February 1955) is a former German professor of [[biology]] who works as an academic advisor at I-Cultiver, Inc. in San Francisco<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://i-cultiver.com/advisors/|title = Advisors}}</ref> and as a visiting scientist in Stanford/Palo Alto, California, US.<ref name="Briggsprofile">{{Cite web|url=https://profiles.stanford.edu/winslow-briggs?tab=publications|title=Winslow Briggs' Profile &#124; Stanford Profiles|website=profiles.stanford.edu}}</ref><ref name=" Systems Biology Group " /><ref name=" I-Cultiver " /> He is the founder and head of "AK Evolutionbiologie", an association of evolutionary biologists in Germany. Starting in the 2000s, Kutschera started engaging with the public, first as a critic of [[creationism]] and [[intelligent design]].<ref name="VBiO"/><ref>Luskin C. [http://www.evolutionnews.org/2008/03/new_plant_evolution_paper_cont004953.html "New plant evolution paper misfires while debating the controversy that doesn't exist."] Evolution News. 6 March 2008.</ref> Since the mid-2010s, his public statements and popular books focused on [[climate skepticism]]<ref>{{Cite web|last=Rudolph|first=Katja|date=2019-03-11|title=Umstrittener Kasseler Biologe wettert gegen "Klima-Hysterie"|trans-title=Controversial Biologist Rants Against 'Climate Hysteria'|url=https://www.hna.de/kassel/oberzwehren-ort131291/kassel-biologe-wettert-gegen-klima-hysterie-ngz-11842324.html|access-date=2021-10-27|website=hna.de|language=de}}</ref> and criticism of [[gender studies]].

==Education and career==
Kutschera completed his undergraduate studies (biology/chemistry; theory of music) at the University of [[Freiburg im Breisgau|Freiburg]], Germany, receiving a MS in zoology and evolutionary biology. In 1985, he received a doctorate degree (PhD) in plant physiology. His thesis (summa cum laude) was awarded the [[Pfizer]] Research Award (Germany) in 1986.

Between 1985 and 1988, Kutschera was the recipient of a Humboldt-fellowship (Feodor Lynen Program). He carried out his post-doctoral work at Stanford University (Department of Biology; Carnegie Institution for Science) and at [[Michigan State University]] (MSU-DOE Plant Research Laboratory). Kutschera was then employed at the [[University of Bonn]] as a research associate and thereafter as a lecturer. He began his professional career in 1993 at the Faculty of Biology and Chemistry (University of Kassel) as full professor and head of a department. In 2007, he joined the Research Groups of Z.-Y. Wang and [[Winslow Briggs|Winslow R. Briggs]] in Stanford, California (US), as a visiting scientist. Since March 2021, Kutschera is a project manager at I-Cultiver, Inc.i in cooperation with [[Rajnish Khanna]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rajnishkhanna.com/|title=Rajnish Khanna|accessdate=6 May 2023}}</ref>

Kutschera is an elected member of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]], Bonn, Germany, and the [[European Society for Evolutionary Biology]] (ESEB). In 2002, he became head of the Arbeitskreis (AK) Evolutionsbiologie (workgroup evolutionary biology) at the {{ill|Verband Deutscher Biologen (vdbiol)|de|Verband Biologie, Biowissenschaften und Biomedizin in Deutschland}}<ref name=" History of vdbiol ">{{Cite web|url=http://www.evolutionsbiologen.de/media/files/2012_KUTSCHERA_HOSSFELD_10-Jahre-AK.pdf|title=History of vdbiol|accessdate=6 May 2023}}</ref> (association of German biologists), and from 2004 to 2007 was vice president.<ref name="VBiO">[http://www.evolutionsbiologen.de "Über uns"]  Accessed August 10, 2018/.</ref> In 2013, Kutschera was elected corresponding member of the [[Botanical Society of America]] (BSA),<ref>[http://www.botany.org/about_bsa/corresponding_members.php "Corresponding members"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080510142108/http://www.botany.org/about_bsa/corresponding_members.php |date=10 May 2008 }} Botanical Society of America.</ref> and, since 2015, he is a Scientific Advisor for the Agriculture-Food-Health Res. Comp. I-Cultiver Inc. based in San Francisco, California, USA,<ref name="I-Cultiver">[https://www.i-cultiver.com/ I-Cultiver, Inc. Agriculture-Food-Health], Livermore CA 94550, USA</ref> and the Systems Biology Group in Palo Alto, California, USA.<ref name="Systems Biology Group">[http://systemsbiologygroup.org/who/ Systems Biology Group], Palo Alto, CA 94306, USA</ref>

After leaving his position at the [[University of Kassel]], he became a board member at the [[Desiderius-Erasmus-Stiftung]], the foundation of [[Alternative for Germany]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Knuth|first=Hannah|date=2018-07-11|title=Rechter Apparat|trans-title=Right Apparatus|url=https://www.zeit.de/2018/29/desiderius-erasmus-stiftung-afd-personalien/komplettansicht|access-date=2021-10-28|website=Zeit Online}}</ref>  A statement accusing the gay community of child abuse and likening [[same-sex marriage]] to ''"state-sponsored [[pedophilia]]"'' drew widespread criticism and became subject of a trial for criminal slander,<ref>{{Cite news|last=Gubernator|first=Sebastian|date=2017-07-20|title=Nach Interview zu Homo-Ehe: "Bemitleidenswerter, hasserfüllter Mensch" – Proteste gegen Professor|language=de|trans-title="Pitiable, hateful person" – protests against professor|work=DIE WELT|url=https://www.welt.de/vermischtes/article166850002/Bemitleidenswerter-hasserfuellter-Mensch-Proteste-gegen-Professor.html|access-date=2021-10-28}}</ref> in which he was acquitted on appeal.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2020-07-20|title=Kutschera-Prozess: "Aussagen geeignet, Gewalt zu erzeugen"|trans-title=Kutschera trial: "statements likely to generate violence"|url=https://www.sueddeutsche.de/leben/gesellschaft-kassel-kutschera-prozess-aussagen-geeignet-gewalt-zu-erzeugen-dpa.urn-newsml-dpa-com-20090101-200720-99-860509|access-date=2021-10-28|website=Süddeutsche.de|language=de}}</ref>

== Scientific work ==
Kutschera has studied the mechanism of [[Plant hormone|phytohormone]]-mediated cell expansion (epidermal growth-control theory of stem elongation; protein secretion hypothesis of auxin action; epiphytic methylobacteria as phytosymbionts in living-fossil plants).<ref name="Kutschera2" /><ref name="Kutschera_Researchgate">{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Ulrich_Kutschera|title=Ulrich KUTSCHERA &#124; Professor of Biology &#124; PhD &#124; Research profile|accessdate=6 May 2023}}</ref>  His contributions to the taxonomy and molecular phylogeny of aquatic [[annelid]]s (and methylobacteria) includes, for example, the discovery/description of the Golden Gate leech; he also revised the [[systematics]] of medicinal leeches and published a theory on the evolution of parental care in the [[Hirudinea]].<ref name=" Kutschera_Researchgate " /><ref name="hirudinea-lamarck1818">{{Cite web|url=http://www.hirudinea-lamarck1818.com/|title=Home|website=www.hirudinea-lamarck1818.com}}</ref>

Kutschera has written about evolution and [[creationism]] from historical and philosophical perspectives and the modern theory of biological evolution as an expanded synthesis, as well as the Synade-model of macroevolution. In 2008, Kutschera described the strict separation of scientific facts and theories from religious dogma in [[Charles Darwin]]'s book ''On the Origin of Species'' (1859) as Darwin's philosophical imperative.<ref name=" Kutschera_Researchgate " /><ref name="Kutschera1">{{Cite journal|title=Darwin's Philosophical Imperative and the Furor Theologicus|first=U.|last=Kutschera|date=December 1, 2009|journal=Evolution: Education and Outreach|volume=2|issue=4|pages=688–694|doi=10.1007/s12052-009-0166-8|doi-access=free}}</ref>

=== Evolution versus intelligent design ===
In 2003, Kutschera said,
:"Anti-evolutionism in German-speaking countries has already infiltrated some academic circles."<ref>Numbers R. L. "The Creationists: from scientific creationism to intelligent design." Harvard University Press, Cambridge, Massachusetts, 2006.</ref>

In 2007, at the annual meeting of the American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS), in San Francisco, US, when speaking about the spread of creationism in Europe, Kutschera said, 
:"The more one argues against this creationist propaganda...the less you can convince people who are not scientists...[we should] no longer talk about Darwinism, but use the term ''Evolutionary Biology'', which is a scientific discipline, like ''[[Physiology]]''."<ref>[http://cosmiclog.nbcnews.com/_news/2007/02/16/4350367-down-with-darwinism?lite "Down with Darwinism."] Cosmic Log, NBC News 16 February 2007.</ref>

In 2015, at the AAAS-meeting in [[San Jose, California|San Jose]], US,<ref>[https://aaas.confex.com/aaas/2015/webprogram/Paper14373.html AAAS-meeting 2015 – Creationism in Germany] American Association for the Advancement of Science, website.</ref> Kutschera argued that 
:"The topic of evolution in Germany is in the hands of a small but powerful religious sect. But they are full of creationist nonsense."<ref>[http://scicom.ucsc.edu/publications/QandA/2015/kutschera.html Science Communication Program] – Interview 2015 by Nala Rogers.</ref>

Kutschera has defended evolution, human biology and naturalism against pseudoscientific claims.<ref>[http://www.dw.de/intelligent-design-debate-arrives-in-germany/a-1829644-1 "Intelligent design debate arrives in Germany."] DW.de.</ref><ref>[http://www.dw.de/german-scientists-concerned-about-rise-in-creationist-belief/a-2222454 "German scientists concerned about rise in creationist belief."] DW.de.</ref>

=== Climate Skepticism ===
In 2019 Kutschera accused the [[School Strike for Climate]] of being motivated by laziness and naively falling pray to ''"climate ideology"''. While he does not deny [[climate change]], he equivocates on [[Human impact on the environment|anthropogemicism]] and considers the topic "hysteria", designed to "make the population more manageable".<ref>{{Cite web|last=Boeselager|first=Matern|date=2016-06-17|title=Wir haben das 'Compact'-Magazin durchgelesen, damit ihr es nicht tun müsst|trans-title=We read through 'Compact' magazine so you don't have to|url=https://www.vice.com/de/article/wir-haben-das-compact-magazin-durchgelesen-damit-ihr-es-nicht-tun-muesst/|access-date=2021-10-28|website=vice.com|language=de}}</ref>

=== Gender studies ===
{{Conservatism in Germany|expanded=Intellectuals}}In a series of interviews promoting and defending his book "[[:de:Das Gender-Paradoxon|The Gender-Paradox (2016)]]", Kutschera railed against [[Gender studies]] as a ''"cancerous growth trying to conquer science".'' He repeatedly asserted "overwhelming" scientific evidence that ''"men across all cultures prefer young, attractive, fertile, not particularly eloquent women, where he doesn't have to discuss much, and she cooks well and raises the children".'' The book itself criticized [[John Money]] (1921–2006) and his concepts of Gender-role etc. (english version of this text, see [https://mercatornet.com/an-evolutionary-biologist-dissects-gender-theory/23574/ here] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210302194320/https://mercatornet.com/an-evolutionary-biologist-dissects-gender-theory/23574/ |date=2 March 2021 }}). The book was generally panned by critics<ref name="hessenschau 02032021">{{Cite web|url=https://www.hessenschau.de/panorama/prozess-wegen-homophober-aussagen-kasseler-professor-freigesprochen,kasseler-biologieprofessor-urteil-100.html|title=Prozess wegen homophober Aussagen: Kasseler Professor freigesprochen|date=2 March 2021|access-date=3 March 2021|archive-date=2 March 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210302185713/https://www.hessenschau.de/panorama/prozess-wegen-homophober-aussagen-kasseler-professor-freigesprochen,kasseler-biologieprofessor-urteil-100.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> which was then criticized as attempted [[censorship]]. Dieter Schönecker wrote that "It is an intellectual catastrophe when contentious people like Ulrich Kutschera, [[Martin van Creveld]], [[Jörg Baberowski]] or [[Rainer Wendt]] are no longer allowed to speak at a German university without the moral police from the 'imperium paternale' (Kant's term for paternal government) being sent out on patrol."<ref name="Schoenecker, D. 2019">[https://philosophynow.org/issues/135/Protecting_Academic_Freedom Protecting Academic Freedom.], Philosophy Now 135, 1–6.</ref>

=== Homosexuality and pedophilia ===
In a 2017 interview with a catholic online magazine, Kutschera predicted that [[Same-sex marriage in Germany|same-sex marriage]], which was at the time in the process of legalization in Germany, would lead to "government-sanctioned pedophilia" and "extensive child abuse". Gay rights organizations and members of the community considered Kutschera's statements to be libelous. A first criminal trial in 2020 found Kutschera guilty of [[Volksverhetzung]] (''incitement to hatred'') and assessed a fine of 6,000 Euro.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kasseler Uniprofessor Ulrich Kutschera legt Revision ein |url=https://www.rtl.de/cms/kasseler-uniprofessor-ulrich-kutschera-legt-revision-ein-4705597.html |access-date=2022-03-26 |website=rtl.de |language=de |archive-date=26 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220326012004/https://www.rtl.de/cms/kasseler-uniprofessor-ulrich-kutschera-legt-revision-ein-4705597.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> After Kutschera succeeded in appealing the verdict, the prosecution appealed and a third trial became necessary. The [[Oberlandesgericht]] in [[Frankfurt]] considered Kutschera's statements to be within the bounds protected by the principle of [[Freedom of speech in Germany|freedom of speech]], leading to acquittal.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Zoske |first=Sascha |date=2022-02-28 |title="Von Meinungsfreiheit gedeckt": Biologe vom Vorwurf der Homosexuellen-Beleidigung freigesprochen |language=de |trans-title=Biologist acquitted of accusation of insulting homosexuals |work=[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]] |url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/rhein-main/biologe-vom-vorwurf-der-beleidigung-homosexueller-freigesprochen-17840285.html |access-date=2022-03-26 |issn=0174-4909}}</ref>

== Publications ==
Kutschera has published ca. 300 scientific papers,<ref name="Kutschera2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed?cmd=search&term=Kutschera+U|title=Kutschera U - Search Results - PubMed|website=PubMed|accessdate=6 May 2023}}</ref> and 14 books (in [[German language|German]]). Since 2010, he is the producer of a series of science videos for biology students, including the "''post-Minimalist 'space music'"'' piano soundtrack.<ref>[https://www.cd-services.com/artist_profile.aspx?id=24 Composers/U. Kutschera], 2 February 2016.</ref><ref name="Lemco">{{Cite web|url=https://zookeeper.stanford.edu/index.php?s=byAlbumKey&n=1097041&action=search&session=|title=Zookeeper Online|website=zookeeper.stanford.edu}}</ref>

His textbook, ''Evolutionsbiologie'' (2015)<ref>Kutschera U. "Evolutionsbiologie", 4th edition,  Verlag Eugen Ulmer, Stuttgart 2015.</ref> has been translated into Russian and Portuguese. In 2018, he published a critical analysis of the scientific validity of [[physiognomy]], with reference to Darwin′s work on this topic.<ref name=" two faces of physiognomy ">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mercatornet.com/conjugality/view/the-two-faces-of-physiognomy/21611|title=MercatorNet: The two faces of physiognomy|website=MercatorNet|date=16 August 2018|access-date=17 August 2018|archive-date=17 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180817125010/https://www.mercatornet.com/conjugality/view/the-two-faces-of-physiognomy/21611|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In January 2019, Kutschera's textbook ''Physiologie der Pflanzen. Sensible Gewächse in Aktion'' was published. In a Book Review, Karl J. Niklas wrote that this volume, which provides a comprehensive summary of our current knowledge on the physiology and biochemistry of plants "… should be of value to general readers interested in the philosophy of science."<ref name="BookreviewNiklas">{{Cite web|url=http://www.evolutionsbiologen.de/media/files/-2019--Niklas_Kutschera_Abstract_klein_Book-review_Historical-roots-and-current--status-of-plant-physiology-01.pdf|title=Niklas, K. J. (2019) Book Review: Historical roots and current status of plant physiology (Abstract)}}</ref> A few weeks before the book became available, a religious webzine published an article dealing with "Plant Intelligence", a topic that was discussed in detail in Kutschera's textbook.<ref name="Merkatornet">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mercatornet.com/features/view/are-plants-intelligent/22014|title=MercatorNet: Are plants intelligent?|website=MercatorNet|date=10 December 2018|access-date=6 February 2019|archive-date=7 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190207020043/https://www.mercatornet.com/features/view/are-plants-intelligent/22014|url-status=dead}}</ref>
